name: drupflare/drupflare
description: Bridges Drupal to Cloudflare Workers bindings: mail, outbound HTTP, images, logging and per-request isolation.

suggest.drupflare/rom: The Drupal 11 database driver for Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite. Needed when the Worker stores the site in the Durable Object rather than in an external database.
suggest.drupal/externalauth: Maps a verified single sign-on identity onto a Drupal account. Required for provider login; without it the host verifies the token and the login is refused.

scripts-descriptions.analyze: Runs PHPStan over src/ at the level pinned in phpstan.neon.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs phpcs with the ruleset in phpcs.xml.dist.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Runs phpcbf over the same ruleset.
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the class-loading gate; needs a Drupal 11.3+ root in $DRUPAL_ROOT or argv[1].
